notes: Starting cards marked (st) in the post: ISB Operations (listed first, unmarked), Coruscant: Imperial Square, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points and Oppressive Enforcement & There Is No Try; they count toward the 60.
The post deliberately leaves 16 of the 23 characters unnamed ('8x ISB agents who are unique imperials with ability<3', '8x other ISB agents'); those two rows are printed as written.

Posted 'Generic Docking Bay' (2x) dested Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark), the generic Dark docking bay; the named Hoth, Yavin 4, Death Star, Cloud City and Endor docking bays dested their Dark printings (Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay) is the Dark Cloud City docking bay).

Posted '5-D6 (unbattleable ISB agent)' dested 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix); 'Ghyyyk' dested Ghhhk; 'J'Quil' dested J'Quille; 'Monok' dested Monnok; 'Nevar Yarnal' dested Nevar Yalnal; '4-LOM w/ Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Oppressive Enforcement & There Is No Try' dested the combo There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement.

Posted 'What Are You Trying To Push On Us' (2x) is the Light A New Hope Effect What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?, which has no Dark printing; it cannot stand in a Dark deck, so the row is printed as written.
